description: This file contains helper functions and type definitions for interacting with a Mindmap API, including fetching graph data, node details, and view state management.

methods.name: fetchMindmapGraph
methods.description: Fetches the mindmap graph data from the API using provided payload.

methods.name: fetchMindmapNodeDetails
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific node in the mindmap.

methods.name: loadMindmapViewState
methods.description: Loads the saved view state for a user from the API.

methods.name: saveMindmapViewState
methods.description: Saves the current view state for a user to the API.
